title: Unit 8: Science Counts: Modals of Ability & Obligation
objective: Mampu berbicara tentang kebiasaan masa lalu, menggunakan 'used to', second conditional (I wish), serta memahami perbedaan past simple vs. past continuous dalam konteks penemuan ilmiah dan kehidupan sehari-hari

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas cara menyatakan kebiasaan di masa lampau dengan 'used to', membayangkan situasi yang berbeda dengan second conditional, dan membedakan past simple dengan past continuous. Dalam konteks sains, kita belajar bagaimana para ilmuwan menemukan hal-hal penting dan bagaimana penemuan tersebut mengubah kehidupan kita.
rules: Used to + verb: untuk menyatakan kebiasaan atau keadaan di masa lalu yang tidak terjadi lagi sekarang. Contoh: 'I used to think that there was a person inside the post box.' / 'People used to read in the evening before they had television.'
Didn't use to + verb: untuk bentuk negatif. Contoh: 'I didn't use to eat the seeds.' / 'He didn't use to be scared of wires.'
Past Simple: untuk aksi yang terjadi pada saat tertentu di masa lalu. Contoh: 'Newton was sitting when an apple fell.'
Past Continuous: untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung di masa lalu atau untuk menggambarkan latar belakang situasi. Contoh: 'While Benjamin Franklin was watching a thunderstorm, he got some ideas.'

Second Conditional: if + past simple, would + verb (untuk situasi yang tidak nyata atau imajiner). Contoh: 'If they found a cure for malaria, life would be easier.' / 'I wish I could go back to when I was a kid.'

commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula keliru saat membuat kalimat negatif dengan 'used to'. Mereka sering menulis 'I didn't used to' padahal seharusnya 'I didn't use to' (tanpa 'd' pada 'use' karena 'did' sudah menunjukkan past tense).
commonTrap.wrong: I didn't used to like science when I was younger.
commonTrap.correct: I didn't use to like science when I was younger.

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara dua siswa membahas kehidupan sebelum adanya teknologi modern

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Did you know that people didn't use to have smartphones?
lines.translation: Tahukah kamu bahwa dulu orang tidak punya smartphone?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Really? What did they use to do for entertainment?
lines.translation: Benarkah? Apa yang dulu mereka lakukan untuk hiburan?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: They used to read books and listen to the radio. Families used to get together and sing songs.
lines.translation: Mereka biasa membaca buku dan mendengarkan radio. Keluarga biasa berkumpul dan bernyanyi bersama.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I wish there was a time machine so I could see what life was like back then.
lines.translation: Saya berharap ada mesin waktu sehingga saya bisa melihat seperti apa kehidupan dulu.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Me too! But I wouldn't want to live without the Internet.
lines.translation: Saya juga! Tapi saya tidak mau hidup tanpa Internet.

speakingLab.context: Simulasi percakapan dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang kebiasaan masa kecilmu dan bagaimana kehidupan berbeda dengan sekarang

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today let's talk about when you were younger. What are some things you used to do or believe?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: When I was little, I used to think that cartoons were real people.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's a lovely memory! And what about habits? Did you use to do anything different from what you do now?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I used to play outside every day with my friends, but now I usually study or use my phone.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Interesting! If you could change one thing about your life now, what would it be? Use 'I wish' to tell me.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I wish I had more time to play sports like I used to.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's a wonderful answer! Well done using 'used to' and 'I wish' correctly. Keep practicing!

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly uses 'used to' in the negative form?
options: I didn't used to like science.
I didn't use to like science.
I don't used to like science.
quiz.answer: I didn't use to like science.
quiz.explanation: Dalam bentuk negatif, kita menggunakan 'didn't use to' (bukan 'didn't used to') karena 'did' sudah menunjukkan past tense.

quiz.question: Complete: 'Before people had electricity, they _____ cook with fire.'
quiz.explanation: 'Used to' digunakan untuk menyatakan kebiasaan di masa lalu yang tidak lagi terjadi sekarang.

quiz.question: Which is the correct second conditional sentence?
options: If I find a cure, life will be easier.
If they found a cure for malaria, life would be easier.
If they find a cure, life would be easier.
quiz.answer: If they found a cure for malaria, life would be easier.
quiz.explanation: Second conditional menggunakan pola: if + past simple, would + verb untuk situasi imajiner atau tidak nyata.

quiz.question: Choose the correct form: 'While Benjamin Franklin _____ (watch) a thunderstorm, he got some ideas.'
quiz.explanation: Past continuous (was watching) digunakan untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung di masa lalu ketika aksi lain terjadi.

quiz.question: What is the difference between 'discovery' and 'invention'?
options: They mean exactly the same thing.
Discovery is finding something that already exists; invention is creating something new.
Discovery is for science; invention is for technology only.
quiz.answer: Discovery is finding something that already exists; invention is creating something new.
quiz.explanation: Discovery adalah menemukan sesuatu yang sudah ada (seperti gravitasi), sedangkan invention adalah menciptakan sesuatu yang baru (seperti smartphone).

quiz.question: Complete with 'I wish': 'The bus isn't here. I wish the bus _____ here.'
quiz.explanation: 'I wish' diikuti oleh past simple untuk menyatakan keinginan tentang situasi sekarang yang berbeda dari kenyataan.
